title: Officer home, case queue and taxpayer profile on the new shell
scope: Rebuild Overview as a workspace home of action items (overdue, awaiting evidence, awaiting approval, failed processing) and the case queue and taxpayer profile as toolbar-plus-table pages with saved views and counts in the sidebar, display options, export of the visible columns and pagination

acceptance.text: The queue has one toolbar row (search, filters, display options, export, one primary action), a usage line, sortable dense table with column help, muted empty values and a row 'Open' action; filters and sort survive reload through the URL
Sidebar views (My cases, Awaiting evidence, Awaiting approval, Overdue) show counts from the same API used by the table; numbers are never invented
Overview and taxpayer profile fit the page-length budget; existing queue e2e tests still pass

Screenshots at 1440, 1024 and 390px with loading, empty, error and denied states, keyboard/focus and axe results, and the TAX-144 page-length result; record relevant tests and evidence, update task status and open a PR

verification: Updated unit and Playwright tests on the fixture build

notes.text: Added 2026-11-08 from ADR-044 (one Vati Workspace identity and design system v2) after the user's UI review against Cloudflare's dashboard and Zoho Workplace.
